dedupeText: retro radio broadcast soundtrack cover 1980s design radio station logo distressed serif cinematic lighting broadcast tower icon patriotic colors text heavy header balanced by a dark atmospheric photographic base red white and blue color scheme linking the graphic elements to the subject matter distressed texture in the title contrasting with the clean sharp lines of the graphic divider warm studio lighting in the photo contrasting with the stark white background of the header combine a stark white header with distressed serif type a central patriotic colored broadcast icon and a low key cinematic photo for a retro media aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered vertical composition featuring a clean white top header with distressed red serif text, a central graphic divider with a radio tower motif, and a low-key, warm-toned photograph of a radio host in a studio setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy header balanced by a dark, atmospheric photographic base
Red, white, and blue color scheme linking the graphic elements to the subject matter
Distressed texture in the title contrasting with the clean, sharp lines of the graphic divider
Warm studio lighting in the photo contrasting with the stark white background of the header
coreInvariants: Distressed texture on the primary display type
Radio tower icon centered on a horizontal rule
High-contrast lighting in the photographic subject
Wide-tracked, clean serif for secondary metadata

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, positioned in profile facing left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central radio tower graphic acts as the fulcrum between the text and the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: Title text leads to the graphic divider, which points down into the highlight on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top provides breathing room for the large title.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation header versus low-value, high-contrast photographic section.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges to simulate stencil or weathered print effects
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed, expressive display type paired with clean, widely-spaced classical metadata type.
graphicDevices: Stylized radio tower icon with lightning bolts

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title
Wide tracking of the footer text
avoid: Bright, flat lighting in the photo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the eroded, historical serif feel of the main title.
Matches the clean, traditional look of the footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic, low-key photograph of a man in profile wearing headphones in a dark 1960s radio studio. Use warm amber rim lighting on his face and a vintage microphone in the foreground. Leave the top 30% of the image as a solid white header area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line centered title in the white header using a distressed red serif font. Below the title, place a horizontal blue line that dips in the center to accommodate a blue radio tower icon with yellow lightning bolts and a red semi-circle with stars. Add wide-tracked black serif text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the title text visibly eroded or weathered?
Is the radio tower graphic centered between the text and the photo?
Is the footer text extremely wide-tracked?
Does the photo have high contrast with warm highlights?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the distress on the title font
Color of the graphic divider (could be monochromatic)
Subject of the photograph (could be a different broadcast setting)
Tracking width of the footer text
mustRedesign: Specific trademarked radio station call signs
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red text doesn't bleed into the white background excessively.
Check that the lightning bolts on the tower are sharp and distinct.
Verify the profile of the subject is clear against the dark background.
Confirm the footer text is perfectly centered and aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a stark white header with distressed serif type, a central patriotic-colored broadcast icon, and a low-key cinematic photo for a retro media aesthetic.
